_readme: v4. The deck has three SLOTS — total, near, far — wired to the template. universes.json decides which PDI universe code feeds each slot and what label appears on the slides; universe codes are opaque strings, never parsed or predicted. The export is an HTML table with universes as columns (code = voters column, code + ' H' = houses column). All percentages are computed as count / that slot's Total row, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP to one decimal. District name = filename stem. Labels matched after normalization so export formatting drift is tolerated. Charts are located by shape name; EVERY shape with a matching name is updated (duplicates across slides are intentional); unrecognized chart shapes and unfound expected names are logged as warnings. NEW in v4: slots absent from the file are skipped (charts blanked, text emptied), and geographic pies are built from 'CA -' rows.

global_placeholders.{{label_total}} / {{label_near}} / {{lab: The 'label' field of the matching slot in universes.json — feeds every column header and table descriptor. Emptied when that slot has no data.

per_slot_placeholders._pattern: Replace <slot> with total, near, or far
per_slot_placeholders.{{share_near}} / {{share_far}}: derived: pct(slot Total voters / total-slot Total voters); no share for the total slot. Emptied (with a warning) when the total slot is absent — there is no denominator.

per_slot_charts._pattern: Shape names are <Slot>_<Kind>: Total_/Near_/Far_ + PartyPie, AgeChart, EthChart, HomePie, CityPie, CouncilPie, SupPie. Every copy of a name is updated.

HomePie.note: PDI row label is 'Homeowner'. Renter is the remainder of the universe total — everyone not flagged homeowner, which includes unknowns.

geographic_charts._pattern: Same <Slot>_<Kind> naming: CityPie, CouncilPie, SupPie. One pie per category — each slice is one geography. Built from rows whose label starts with 'CA -'. Council District is tested before City so 'City of X Council District N' is never swallowed by the city pattern. All matching is case-insensitive; supervisorial ordinals (1st, 2nd, 11th...) are handled generally.

CityPie.source_rows: 'CA - City Of <Name>' and 'CA - Town Of <Name>' (treated identically) plus 'CA - Uninc - ...'
CityPie.slice_labels: City/town name as written in the export; the unincorporated row is labeled 'Unincorporated' (county name discarded)
CityPie.coverage_check: Cities + unincorporated should cover ~100% of each universe; outside 98-102% a WARNING with the actual total appears in the run summary (never fatal)

CouncilPie.slice_labels: D<n> when all districts share one parent city; '<City> D<n>' when districts from multiple cities appear in one file (plain D<n> would collide)
CouncilPie.order: Numeric (D1, D2, ... D10 — not lexicographic); multi-city files sort city-first, then numeric

geographic_charts.unrecognized: Any other 'CA -' row is logged by name in the run summary and never guessed at (e.g. State Senate district rows).
geographic_charts.sizing: Slice value = geography count / that slot's Total row, half-up one decimal. No slice cap, no 'rest of district' grouping.
geographic_charts.label_caveat: The pies use PowerPoint's automatic percent labels, which normalize to the plotted total. For cities (~100% coverage) the displayed % equals the universe share. For council/supervisorial pies the displayed % is the share among the charted districts, since those don't cover the whole universe. Slice proportions always follow the universe-share values.

partial_data_behavior.absent_slot: A slot whose universe (and alternates) aren't in the file is skipped: its charts are BLANKED (series cleared, renders empty — never template dummy values), its text placeholders emptied (incl. its label), its summary-table rows removed.
partial_data_behavior.absent_geo_category: A geographic category with no rows in the file blanks its pies for every slot.
partial_data_behavior.slide_deletion: A slide is deleted when it contains at least one chart and EVERY chart on it was blanked. Chartless slides are never deleted. Removed slides are listed in the run summary.
partial_data_behavior.table_rows: A table body row is removed when it contained placeholders and every one of them resolved to empty (static scaffolding text doesn't save a data-less row).
partial_data_behavior.run_summary: Every run ends with a RUN SUMMARY block: slots filled/empty and why, geographic slice counts, unrecognized rows, charts blanked, slides removed, placeholders emptied, warnings.

still_fatal: No deck is written when: the file has no parsable table or no Description header; NONE of the configured universes are present; a required standard segment row is missing; a count is non-numeric or negative; a present universe fails validation (party sum <= TOTAL, age buckets ~TOTAL, ethnicity remainder non-negative, early+late VBM <= TOTAL, Homeowner <= TOTAL); the template contains an unknown {{placeholder}}. A present universe whose Total is 0 is demoted to absent with a warning.
